BandX.summary: A vertical shaded reference interval spanning the visible frame.

x0.doc: The interval's starting x coordinate: a number, date or column.

x1.doc: The interval's ending x coordinate: a number, date or column.

legend.doc: Include the band in a legend.

data.doc: A table for this band alone.

BandY.summary: A horizontal shaded reference interval spanning the visible frame.

y0.doc: The interval's starting y coordinate: a number, date or column.

y1.doc: The interval's ending y coordinate: a number, date or column.

legend.doc: Include the band in a legend.

data.doc: A table for this band alone.

BulletChart.summary: Actual values, target ticks and supplied qualitative ranges on categorical rows.

x.doc: The actual value for each bullet.

target.doc: Optional target value for each bullet.

fields.doc: Columns of cumulative qualitative upper bounds, all at or above baseline.

baseline.doc: The common starting value for actual and range bars.

bandFraction.doc: The share of a category band occupied by the actual bar.

ranges.doc: Props of the background Bar part, such as fill, fillScale and opacity.

tick.doc: Props of the target Prism part, such as fill, width and depth.

data.doc: A table for this chart alone.

Candlestick.summary: Prices over time as candles: a wick from each period's low to its high, and a body from its open to its close.

data.doc: A table for this mark alone: a mark with data displays on its own, in a Plot of its own.

x.doc: The column of the periods along x, one candle each.

open.doc: The column of each period's opening price.

high.doc: The column of each period's highest price.

low.doc: The column of each period's lowest price.

close.doc: The column of each period's closing price.

bandFraction.doc: The share of its period's band each body fills, 0 to 1; on a numeric or date axis, the body's width in the axis's units (milliseconds for dates).

wick.doc: The wicks' own props, as one object: {color: "black", width: 2}. They are a Segments, gray and 1 px wide by default.

Dumbbell.summary: Two values per category, as points joined by a stem: before and after, or two groups.

data.doc: A table for this mark alone: a mark with data displays on its own, in a Plot of its own.

y.doc: The categories along y, one dumbbell each.

x0.doc: The column of each dumbbell's first value.

x1.doc: The column of each dumbbell's second value.

stem.doc: The stems' own props, as one object: {color: "black", width: 1}. They are a Segments, gray and 2 px wide by default.

EndLabels.summary: Labels at the ends of lines: each series' name or value beside its last (or first) point.

x.doc: The line's x: the label sits beside the end point's.

series.doc: The column naming each line, as the Line's series; without it, one label at the data's end.

text.doc: What each label says: a column (numbers are written as Text writes them) or a literal.

format.doc: How numbers in the text are written: a d3-format string (",.0f", ".1%"), or a %-pattern for dates.

at.doc: Which end of each series is labelled.

dx.doc: How far right of its point each label starts (left of it when negative; at the first end, its default is -6 and the label ends there).
dx.defaultText: 6 at the last end, -6 at the first

data.doc: A table for this mark alone.

ForestPlot.summary: Point estimates with horizontal confidence intervals on categorical rows.

lower.doc: Each interval's absolute lower x endpoint.

upper.doc: Each interval's absolute upper x endpoint.

reference.doc: Optional reference value along x; omitted means no reference line.

interval.doc: Props of the horizontal ErrorBars part, such as color, width and capSize.

referenceLine.doc: Props of the optional RuleX part, such as color and width.

data.doc: A table for this chart alone.

IntervalTimeline.summary: Task intervals on categorical rows, with optional milestone points.

y.doc: The categorical task or lane for each interval.

x0.doc: The start of each interval, as numeric or datetime values.

x1.doc: The end of each interval, in the same units as x0.

milestone.doc: Optional milestone x values, one per task; missing values draw no point.

milestones.doc: Props of the milestone Points part, such as shape, size and fill.

bandFraction.doc: The share of each task's category band filled by its interval.

data.doc: A table for this chart alone.

Sparkline.summary: A compact line with an optional reference band and final-value label.

x.doc: The ordered x coordinates of the line.

lower.doc: Optional reference band's lower y bound; supply upper too.

upper.doc: Optional reference band's upper y bound; supply lower too.

text.doc: Optional column, dictionary text or literal for the final finite row; numbers are written as Text writes them.

band.doc: Props of the BandY reference part, such as fill and opacity.

last.doc: Props of the final-row Text part, such as color, dx, dy and size.

data.doc: A table for this chart alone.

Waterfall.summary: A running total built from changes: each bar steps from the total before it to the total after it.

data.doc: A table for this mark alone: a mark with data displays on its own, in a Plot of its own.

x.doc: The column of the steps along x, one bar each, in row order.

y.doc: The column of each step's change: positive steps up, negative steps down.

bandFraction.doc: The share of its step's band each bar fills, 0 to 1; on a numeric axis, the bar's width in data units.
